title: How to Cancel ExpressVPN — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel ExpressVPN subscription and get a refund within 30 days. Turn off auto-renewal to avoid future charges. Complete instructions.
intro: ExpressVPN offers a 30-day money-back guarantee — if you're within that window, you get a full refund. After 30 days, you can still turn off auto-renewal to prevent future charges.

steps.title: Sign in to your ExpressVPN account
steps.text: Visit expressvpn.com/subscriptions and sign in with your credentials.

steps.title: Turn off auto-renewal
steps.text: In your subscription settings, find the auto-renewal toggle and turn it off. This prevents future charges when your current plan expires.

steps.title: Request a refund if within 30 days
steps.text: If you're within 30 days of purchase: contact ExpressVPN support via live chat. Tell them you want to cancel and request a refund under the money-back guarantee.
steps.tip: Live chat is the fastest method. Be direct: 'I'd like to cancel and request a refund under your 30-day guarantee.'

steps.title: Confirm via email
steps.text: You'll receive email confirmation of the cancellation. Refunds typically process within 5-7 business days depending on payment method.

warnings: After 30 days, no refund is available — but you can stop auto-renewal and keep VPN access until your plan expires.
ExpressVPN often sells 12-month plans. Turning off auto-renewal means you keep the full remaining time.
If purchased through Apple App Store, cancel through iOS subscription settings.
Bitcoin/cryptocurrency payments may take longer to refund.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from ExpressVPN?
faqs.a: Yes, within 30 days of purchase under their money-back guarantee. Contact live chat support. After 30 days, no refund is available.

faqs.q: How long does an ExpressVPN refund take?
faqs.a: Typically 5-7 business days for credit cards. PayPal may be faster (2-3 days). Bitcoin refunds are processed in the original cryptocurrency.

faqs.q: Will my ExpressVPN account be deleted?
faqs.a: After cancellation, your account remains but without active VPN service. You can reactivate anytime with a new subscription.

faqs.q: What's a good free VPN alternative?
faqs.a: ProtonVPN (free tier with unlimited data, 3 servers), Windscribe (10GB/month free), and WARP by Cloudflare (free, fast, but limited privacy) are reputable free options.

refund.details: Full 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked. Contact live chat to process. After 30 days, no refund but you keep access until your plan expires.

retentionTactics: Live chat agents may offer an extended subscription at a discount.
They may ask if there's a specific issue they can help resolve before processing cancellation.
